title: Rotation utilities for symbolic user items: the functions of cUtilities with an argument functions
author: Claude-JG
description: A selected list of the functions of exudyn.cUtilities / rigidBodyUtilities useful for symbolic user items, in a new module, with the same names and arguments plus a last argument functions (default exudyn.symbolic), which may also be exudyn.cMath, numpy or math; check first what fails or is missing; then adapt the test scripts (userRigidBodyTest.py, ...), which shrink. First the analysis and recommendation (docs/dev/design/symbolicUtilities.md).
releaseNotes: New module exudyn.symbolicUtilities: 21 rotation and kinematics functions of exudyn.cUtilities / rigidBodyUtilities (Skew, Cross, Inertia6D2InertiaTensor, RotationMatrixX/Y/Z, RotationMatrix2D, the Tait-Bryan, Euler-parameter and rotation-vector rotation matrices, G matrices and their derivatives) with the same names and arguments and a last argument functions: with exudyn.symbolic (default) they take symbolic values and return symbolic matrices and vectors for symbolic user functions, with numpy, math or exudyn.cMath they return numpy arrays; test model symbolicUtilitiesTest.py, userRigidBodyTest.py uses it.
